parsed.why: No criminalisation, marriage, urban acceptance; but documented police extortion and raids on trans people, impunity for trans killings, raw counts lacking denominators, and progressive law widely unenforced.

Traveller-facing tier-1 exposure: sex-at-birth passport/visa rules, border refusal instructions, allied advisories, detentions, facility bans criminalised in four states, custody harm, partly offset by courts.
Same-sex statute as police lever: anti-LGBTQ crimes not investigated, pretext imprisonment, no recognition, hostile society with thin recourse; no facilities or border machinery documented.

No criminalisation, court-ordered self-determined markers, third-gender documents, Pride; but documented harassment of visibly trans people in public institutions, provincial and rural violence, recent leader-linked hate speech.

Rule-of-law state, no criminalisation, registered partnerships; no trans-specific violence, police abuse or facility rules documented, only hate-crime enforcement failures later reopened after a regional court ruling.
